anomalies.observed: The LDO REG2 output is on the +3.3V net, but the separate +3V3 net used by MCU-related pull-ups, connectors, and NAVC1 VBAT has no source. All FCC1 and NAVC1 VDD pins are placed in unconnected-(...VDD...) nets.
anomalies.expected: The 3V3 LDO output should feed both MCUs and the +3V3 rail; MCU VDD pins must be connected to the 3.3 V supply.

evidence.quote: 3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs

anomalies.impact: The MCUs and the +3V3 pull-up/connector rail are unpowered; the board cannot boot or operate as intended.

anomalies.observed: NAVC1 has no nodes on the sensor I2C bus, the FCC UART2/I2C/GPIO link, NRST, BOOT0, or HSE nets. The FCC HSE crystal is connected to PE6/PE7 instead of the MCU HSE pins PH0/PH1.
anomalies.expected: NAVC1 should be connected to its sensors and to FCC via UART2/I2C/GPIO, and both MCU 25 MHz HSE crystals should connect to the MCU HSE pins PH0/PH1.

evidence.quote: NAVC↔FCC run UART2 + I2C + GPIO between the two MCUs
HSE crystal (both MCUs) ... ABM8G-25.000MHZ-4Y-T3 ... High Speed External Crystal

anomalies.impact: The navigation computer is effectively disconnected from sensors, FCC, reset, boot, and its external clock; the FCC HSE clock is also not applied to the correct pins, preventing intended operation and timing.

anomalies.observed: FCC1 VCAP pins 48 and 73 are connected to UART3_TX_FCC and UART3_RX_FCC, which go to the UART3 connector; no bypass capacitors are present on these VCAP nets.
anomalies.expected: STM32H753 VCAP pins are internal core regulator outputs and must be decoupled to GND with capacitors, not connected to UART signals.
anomalies.impact: Core decoupling is merged with UART3 signals, compromising MCU power integrity and loading the UART3 connector; the MCU may not operate reliably even if other power issues were corrected.
